def generate_sequence(n):
    if n == 1:
        return "1337"
    
    # Initialize the dp array where dp[i] will store the number of ways to form i subsequences
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    
    # Initialize the prefix sum array to keep track of cumulative sums
    prefix_sum = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    # Iterate over each possible length of the sequence
    for length in range(1, n + 1):
        # Update the dp array based on the previous values
        for j in range(length - 1, -1, -1):
            dp[length] += dp[j]
        
        # Update the prefix sum array
        prefix_sum[length] = prefix_sum[length - 1] + dp[length]
    
    # Construct the sequence using the dp array
    result = []
    current_length = n
    while current_length > 0:
        for digit in [7, 3, 1]:
            if prefix_sum[current_length - 1] >= dp[current_length - 1]:
                result.append(str(digit))
                break
        
        current_length -= 1
    
    return ''.join(result)
